main_negative_result: The frozen seven numerical formulas are strongly basis-dependent and therefore cannot themselves be fundamental Wilson coefficients.  The local operator and canonical normalization must be derived first; effective controls are then outputs.
recommended_operator_ansatz: 4D-Lorentz-symmetric position-dependent kinetic kernel plus a local kink mass and the Hessian-basis connection; generation dependence enters through a small, separately specified flavor generator/spurion sector.
